---
indicator_code: "CUR-001"
indicator_name: "Claims Under Review"
definition: |
  Tracks the **volume and value of claims currently held in any review stage**. The metric gives   SHA and DHA a real-time picture.

  Four review categories are recognised:

  | Statuses Considered Under Review |
  |---|
  | Medical Review |
  | Clinical Review |
  | Manual Review |
  | Approved |
  | Payment Partial |
  | Queued |
  | Resubmitted Missing Documents |
  | Sent for Payment Processing |
  | Sent to Surveillance |
  | Decline |

numerator: |
  Count or sum of claim values where for statuses listed in definition above.
denominator: |
  - Not applicable
unit_of_measure: |
  - **Count** — whole number of claims
  - **Value** — Kenya Shillings (KES), displayed in Billions (B) on charts
data_source: |
  - Payor system
frequency: |
  - Daily, Weekly, Monthly
disaggregation: |
  - Review category (Medical / Clinical / Manual / Other Under Review)
  - Period
  - County
  - Facility 
sdg_who_ref: |
  **SDG 3.8** — Achieve universal health coverage, including financial risk protection
  and access to quality essential health care services. Reducing the under-review backlog
  is a proxy for timely provider reimbursement and UHC system efficiency.
notes_caveats: |
    Not applicable
---
